anya: 🚀 Launch day! We just crossed `1,250,372` requests in 24h — unbelievable. Huge props to infra + runtime teams. Bring the noise! :tada:
sam: omg amazing, congrats team!! :confetti_ball:
jordan: +1 to a tiny gong in the kitchen. when's the in-person high-five? :handshake:
mica: Cake? Bagels? Poll: react with :bagel: for bagels, :cake: for cake, :taco: for tacos, :ice_cream: for ice cream — place your emoji votes
ryan: Can ops-bot confirm zero deploy incidents last 24h? also massive shoutout to the batcher tuning work, saved a ton of tokens
ops-bot: @ryan All checks green — no failed deploys and p95 latency < 120ms across regions. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Deployment 2026.03.23-123 succeeded (canary -> prod) :rocket:
sam: love that, picnic tomorrow? i'm voting :bagel:
jordan: :cake: for me, but i'll eat anything. also who stole my plant last week? kidding :stuck_out_tongue:
mica: also made a celebratory playlist — https://open.spotify.com/playlist/example (drop songs in)
anya: tiny trivia — first person to bring a non-virtual gong to the office gets a surprise sticker pack :wink:
ryan: tiny stickers > big ego. congrats everyone — hard work paid off :raised_hands:
sam: selfie booth at 3pm? i'll bring a polaroid, props to anyone who wears a party hat
jordan: posting a GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-3o6Zt8MgUuvSbkZYWc :partying_face:
mica: if anyone's remote, we'll do a 5-min 'virtual gong' at 4:00pm PT — feel free to join, mute if you hate noise :joy:
anya: thanks team. short and silly thread but huge thanks to everyone who pushed this over the line :heart:
